issue.title: Tidy up old issues, and how do I see our version?
issue.body:
We upgraded our instance last week and everything we'd reported seems fine now.
Please close these old issues, ours and the ones other customers opened about
the same things: #4203, #4206, #4304, #4313 and #4406. They're only clutter at
this point.

Also, how can I check which version our instance is actually running? Our
hosting provider says 3.2.1, but I'd like to see it for myself.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

To see the running version, call the health endpoint at the root of the API (GET /, the readiness check). Its JSON response includes a "version" field taken from the package version the instance was started with. The liveness endpoint (GET /live) returns only a status. Nothing in the code needs to change for this.

Closing #4203, #4206, #4304, #4313 and #4406 is not something triage can do; a maintainer will need to review those issues separately.
